'''Hermann Lotter''' (7 March 1940 &ndash; 5 June 2013) was a German [[Swimming (sport)|swimmer]]. He competed in the [[1960 Summer Olympics]] and the [[1964 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/lo/hermann-lotter-1.html |title=Hermann Lotter Olympic Results |accessdate=21 October 2016 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20161022031633/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/lo/hermann-lotter-1.html |archivedate=22 October 2016 |df=dmy-all }}</ref>
